subject: Request: Vulnerability post‑mortem + remediation evidence for SOC2 audit
messages:
From: Sam Owen <sam.owen@brightline.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: security@brightline.com, compliance@brightline.com
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Vulnerability post‑mortem + remediation evidence for SOC2 audit

Hi Rachel,

Brightline is preparing for a scheduled SOC 2 readiness review next week and our auditors have asked us to provide evidence of your vulnerability management posture for a sample window (Mar–May 2026). Specifically they're requesting:

- Scan cadence logs for the last 90 days (dates/timestamps, scanner IDs).
- Proof of remediation for the critical CVE listed in our intake (CVE‑2026‑3344): timeline of detection → triage → patch deployment → verification.
- A signed attestation that your internal SLA for CVE triage/patch falls within the commitments in your SOC 2 disclosure (we have a copy of the disclosure but need a one-off attestation for our file).

Can you provide a compact packet (scan export + remediation workbook + a 1‑page postmortem summary + signed attestation) by EOD Wednesday, May 20? If you expect any scope gaps (third‑party dependencies, out-of-scope assets), note them in the packet.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.

Sam Owen
Security Engineer, Brightline
security@brightline.com

Attachment: requested_sample_template.csv (example of expected fields)
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Sam Owen <sam.owen@brightline.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Vulnerability post‑mortem + remediation evidence for SOC2 audit

Sam —

Thanks for the heads up and clear list. We can assemble the packet and will aim to deliver by EOD Wednesday (May 20). A couple quick clarifying points so we produce exactly what you need:

- Do you need raw scan exports for every asset, or a filtered export for assets in scope for Brightline (we can provide either; filtered reduces noise)?
- For CVE‑2026‑3344 we have remediation logged across a few internal components and a third‑party library; do you want the third‑party remediation evidence included (we can include vendor communication as "out‑of‑scope with compensating control")?

We'll include the timeline, verification evidence, and a one‑page summary. Attestation will be routed to our security ops lead for signature.

If that works, I'll loop in our ops team and send the consolidated packet.

Best,
Rachel
Senior Customer Security Manager
Redwood Inference

---

Irene / Ben —

FYI Brightline needs a compact VM evidence packet by EOD Wed 5/20. Request summary: 90‑day scan cadence export, CVE‑2026‑3344 remediation timeline + verification, 1‑page postmortem, signed attestation.

Ben: can you pull the scanner exports (Mar 20 → May 18), and build the remediation workbook with per‑CVE rows (detection timestamp, owner, patch commit / CVE ticket, verification run timestamp)? Please flag any assets we should consider out of scope for Brightline and why.

Irene: can you draft/sign the attestation? It should be a one‑paragraph confirmation that our stated SLA (triage within 48 hours for critical, remediation within 30 days for critical where patch is available) was followed for the sample, with an explicit callout for the CVE timeline. If you want, I can draft and you can edit/sign.

I'll assemble a 1‑page postmortem summary and a Drive folder link for delivery.

Thanks — tight timeline here.
Rachel

Third‑party component: the vulnerable library was updated by vendor and we applied the update in our managed dependency pipeline; vendor advisory (vendor‑advisory.pdf) is listed in the postmortem and Drive.

I'm including a shared Drive link with the packet for download: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/brightline/vm-evidence-2026

Sam —

Thanks for your patience. Attached is the compact evidence packet for Brightline's SOC 2 sample window:

- scan_log_may2026.csv (90‑day scanner export for assets in scope)
- cve_remediation_sheet.xlsx (per‑CVE timeline, ticket links, deploy job IDs)
- postmortem_summary.pdf (1‑page: scope, detection→remediation chronology, verification approach, third‑party note)
- attestation_letter_signed.pdf (signed attestation from our Security Ops lead)

Summary of the CVE you called out (CVE‑2026‑3344): detection 2026‑04‑02 → patch applied 2026‑04‑09 → verification scan clear on 2026‑04‑09. Our documented SLA for critical CVEs is triage within 48 hours and remediation within 30 days when a patch is available; the sample timeline for CVE‑2026‑3344 meets that SLA.

Drive link for full packet (same files): https://drive.redwood.com/shared/brightline/vm-evidence-2026

If the auditor needs any additional raw logs (syslog correlates, deploy job manifests), let us know a narrow list and we can pull those next‑day.

Best regards,
Rachel Kim
